bibliographic.title: Berta Multiplicada / Berta Multiplied
bibliographic.author: Ruber Eaglenest
bibliographic.description:
An interactive song by / Una canción interactiva por Ruber Eaglenest.

Inspired by the song of the same name by / Inspirada por la canción Berta Multiplicada de Christina Rosenvinge.

(The Spanish version was entered into ECTOCOMP 2025's Le Grand Guignol (Spanish) as Muerte de Berta Cáceres. A year later, the English translation was entered into ECTOCOMP 2026's Le Grand Guignol (English).)
